ranked_facts.why: Bilateral lens dislocation is more characteristic of Marfanoid features, such as homocystinuria, which is a part of B1, than of general connective tissue disorders like B2.

Long slender fingers, also known as arachnodactyly, are a hallmark feature of Marfanoid syndromes, which are included in B1, distinguishing them from multisystem developmental disorders like those in B3.
